evidence.text: Pantry Pals is a free recipe and meal-planning app for home cooks. Download it on iOS and Android, scan what is in your fridge and get dinner ideas in seconds.
Pantry Pals Plus costs 3.99 per month and removes ads. Families can share one Plus subscription across up to six phones.
